learning_outcomes.text: Explain TypeScript's role and the type system over JavaScript
Annotate variables, functions and objects with types
Use interfaces, type aliases and unions
Use generics for reusable typed code
Apply type narrowing and type guards
Configure the compiler and understand strictness

integrative_case: Add type safety to a JavaScript module: annotate its functions and data shapes with interfaces, introduce a union type with narrowing for a result value, make a utility generic, and turn on strict compiler options to catch errors.
